gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-preahvihear: Nasalization floats its letters well apart, each one drawn like bent wire. Preahvihear underneath carries more body, its lofty x-height and open mouths giving the spaced-out heading something sturdy to lean on.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-puritan: Nasalization draws its letters with a fixed-width nib, spacing them out so each one has room to float. Nasalization grabs the eye; Puritan, with its rounded open forms, does the carrying.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-questrial: Nasalization spaces its letters far apart, with a c opened like a pair of calipers. Questrial then brings flat, single-weight strokes and a tall letter band, and that steadiness is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-radio-canada-: A c opened like a pair of calipers gives Nasalization its signature, with letters floating well apart. And Radio Canada Big keeps paragraphs moving, its tall x-height filling the line and terminals stopping short of the stem.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-roboto: Wiry and widely spaced, Nasalization draws curves that match its stems exactly, with a c opened like calipers. Nasalization gets the showing off; Roboto, with generous round mouths, does the reading.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-sofia-sans-se: Friendly and loose, Nasalization lets its letters float well apart. Nasalization handles the welcome, while Sofia Sans Semi Condensed holds the text with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-devanagari: Bright, unbroken tubes of line: Neon keeps every stroke the full width, with no thin parts lost in glare. Yet Anek Devanagari settles in underneath, its open letter mouths and tall middle zone keeping paragraphs smooth.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-kannada: Neon draws one uninterrupted line, bent like a straw into tall lowercase forms, spaced openly throughout. And Anek Kannada, with its high woodblock-like x-height and far-off terminals, is what makes the pair feel sturdy.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Glowing and vibrant, Neon runs a single unbroken line through tall, open-set lowercase letters. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Next steps in with big-eyed lowercase and unlatched rounds, so the loud heading has a quiet partner.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads tall and open, with a high-set x-height. Neon supplies the glow with diagonals matching its horizontals, and that gap in energy next to the modest body is the pair's best quality.
